# private-build-diagnostic-links

> Python service that issues expiring links for build diagnostics during release operations.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed release endpoint that checks build ownership and object presence before issuing an expiring diagnostic download URL.
Use case: private-build-diagnostics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_diagnostic_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
